title: Managing Tantrums with Mindfulness
content: After several sessions with Dr. Emily Stanton, we've seen a significant improvement in handling tantrums in our child, who is being raised in an LGBT family environment. Key strategies include acknowledging feelings, deep breathing exercises, and using calm-down jars.

title: Progress Report: Therapy Sessions
content: Progress has been remarkable since implementing the strategies from Dr. Stanton for our child, part of an LGBT family. Tantrums have decreased in frequency and intensity. Continued support and reinforcement of positive behavior are crucial.

title: Book List for Emotional Growth
content: Books are a great tool for teaching self-regulation, especially in children of LGBT parents. 'The Colorful World' by A.J. Harmony and 'When I Feel Angry' by Cornelia Maude Spelman are excellent starts.
